hook: The apostles asked: how do we honour Christmas?

verse.translation: …the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.

story: When people asked why His disciples didn't fast, Jesus said that while the bridegroom was with them they couldn't mourn, but the days would come when He was taken away, and then they would fast.

The church teaches that after the Ascension the apostles said: we honour the Resurrection by keeping the Great Lent before it, so how shall we honour His birth? They kept the prophets' fast before the Nativity.
So Tsome Nebiyat is also called Tsome Hawariat, the Fast of the Apostles. (It's separate from the other Fast of the Apostles, kept after Pentecost.)
meaning: The prophets fasted before Christ came. The apostles, who had walked with Him, fasted too. Today is also a Wednesday, one of the two fast days of every week.

sources.title: ጾመ ነቢያት: አስተምህሮ፣ ስብከት፣ ብርሃንና ኖላዊ (Astemhro, church teaching on the Fast of the Prophets)
